nodes.summary: The configuration space `E → Bool` of a statistical-mechanics model with sites (or bonds) indexed by `E`, carrying the product topology and the product σ-algebra.
nodes.title: Configuration space of a statistical-mechanics model

nodes.summary: The coordinate projection `ω ↦ ω e` of a configuration at the site `e`.
nodes.title: Coordinate projection of a configuration

nodes.summary: The product σ-algebra on `ConfigSpace E` is generated by the coordinate projections; this holds by definition of `MeasurableSpace.pi`.
nodes.title: Product σ-algebra on configuration space is generated by the coordinates

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
